title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Preparations for the Japanese Derby have been going well, but just before the race, Satono Diamond notices her shoes are torn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She brought a backup pair, so it isn't a problem, but all the same, she can feel the power of the jinx at work to prevent her from achieving her dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if to shake off her anxiety, she confidently declares that she's going to win.
